fusions.name: Named Quarry
fusions.desc: Speaks a word at a target carrying one of your afflictions, using it up to deal 8 damage.

fusions.name: Litany of Pursuit
fusions.desc: Intones a litany that deals 25 damage to everything in a cone 5 tiles ahead of you. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Word of Stillness
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to speak, then holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Litany
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
